copy:
some couples come with
private captions
outfit: Aachu in white wrap shirt, jeans, red bag; Zuv in pale blue shirt and grey trousers
visual: Aachu and Zuv walk through a small city moment while everyone else blurs into simple linework. Tiny unlabelled ghost captions float around strangers, but the main hook sits clearly above the couple.
cta_intent: make viewers understand the deck as a universal love-reading format

location: home doorway with a half-packed tote
outfit: Aachu in oversized kurta and loose hair; Zuv in simple dark tee
visual: Aachu stands in the doorway performing a tiny dramatic exit with slippers still inside. Zuv holds the door and her tote like this is a real operation, calm but fully invested.
cta_intent: tag the person who takes your drama seriously

outfit: Aachu in soft sweater and pajama pants; Zuv in rolled-sleeve home shirt
visual: Aachu sits by a rainy window with phone in hand and tense shoulders. Zuv sits close with phone down, leaning in, listening before solving.
cta_intent: show love as kind interpretation under stress

outfit: Aachu in printed dress or bright dupatta; Zuv in casual jacket
visual: Aachu lights up over a tiny dessert or street find. Zuv watches her smile instead of the object, visibly happy because she is happy.
cta_intent: make viewers recognize the person who enjoys their joy

outfit: Aachu in denim jacket and red shoes; Zuv in cream sweater
visual: Aachu judges one random item with a clear dislike face. Zuv is already putting it back with serious agreement, on her side before the debate starts.
cta_intent: tag the partner who joins your tiny judgments

outfit: Zuv in dark jacket holding scarf or bag; Aachu in long coat and warm scarf
visual: Zuv performs toughness while carrying something sweet or protective. Aachu looks at him with a private smile because she knows the softness underneath.
cta_intent: make the private caption mutual, not only about her

location: parked car or late evening roadside chai stop
outfit: Aachu in casual travel hoodie; Zuv in open overshirt
visual: Zuv tells a bad joke and laughs at himself. Aachu looks at him with soft affection, like the laugh is the thing she came for.
cta_intent: make viewers send it to the person whose laugh feels like home

copy:
the right person
captions you kindly
location: rooftop at blue hour with soft lights
outfit: Aachu in simple saree or long dress; Zuv in linen shirt
visual: Aachu and Zuv sit side by side under small lights, with a few tiny private-label scraps from earlier moments tucked around them like memories. The final line sits cleanly above them.
cta_intent: final sendable line for everyone in love
